description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Listings Operations team owns the operational playbooks and cross-functional rhythms that let Coinbase launch new assets cleanly across the EU, LATAM, APAC, and beyond. As an International Expansion Operations Associate, you'll partner with Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and regional teams to standardize launch workflows across jurisdictions and keep requirements clear and documented as we scale into new markets.

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end operational planning for asset listings in new market entries, ensuring compliance, liquidity, and support workflows are aligned for a high-trust launch day experience
  • Translate regulatory, product, and compliance requirements into scalable, documented processes that support growth across multiple jurisdictions
  • Drive resolution of cross-regional bottlenecks by analyzing workflow data, identifying root causes, and implementing scalable solutions
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and regional teams to align on SLAs, escalation paths, and launch readiness criteria
  • Build and maintain internal playbooks for region-specific approval workflows, launch checklists, and operational requirements
  • Establish feedback loops with regional stakeholders and leadership to surface risks, share status, and capture learnings that improve future launches

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 3+ years in international operations, global program management, or a similar cross-functional operations role in fintech, crypto, payments, or a regulated industry
  • Proven success leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across at least two geographic regions (EMEA, APAC, or LATAM) with regulatory and operational complexity
  • Demonstrated ability to design and document scalable operational processes, including familiarity with Lean Six Sigma or similar process optimization methodologies
  • Proficiency in AI tools and Google Sheets (or Excel), with working knowledge of SQL or data analysis tools such as Snowflake considered a plus
  • Effective cross-functional communicator who has influenced alignment across Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams on competing priorities
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

 

Req ID: P79077

Pay Transparency Notice: The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision).

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
£73,435—£77,300 GBP
